representative_seed_contract: seed 0 is the unperturbed shared initialization; it is fixed before held-out evaluation and is not chosen by held-out score

matrix_semantics.T_base_Ci: T^B_Ci; fixed-camera coordinates to robot-base coordinates; final deployable extrinsic; 4x4 SE(3), translation in meters
matrix_semantics.T_gripper_cam: T^G_C; wrist-camera coordinates to robot-gripper coordinates; final deployable hand-eye transform; 4x4 SE(3), translation in meters
matrix_semantics.T_base_board: T^B_board; board coordinates to robot-base coordinates; optimized target pose, not a camera calibration deliverable
matrix_semantics.T_base_cube_by_set: T^B_cube(s); cube coordinates to robot-base coordinates for each set; optimized/fixed target pose, not a camera calibration deliverable
